title: Manyhands JSON v1 preview effect
description: One thing a command that needs confirmation will do, as an entry of its preview's effects. head_moved: HEAD is made to name the primary branch, in a repository whose HEAD names another branch that has no commit. worktree_exclusion_written: the repository's own exclude file, .git/info/exclude, is made to ignore the directory Manyhands keeps its worktrees in. remote_removed: the remote is taken out of the repository's own Git configuration; with it Git removes the remote's tracking references (remote_tracking_refs_removed) and the upstream of every local branch that follows it (branch_upstreams_removed), each listed when the repository has any.
